description: Retrieve documents from a collection by ids or filter.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection to retrieve documents from.

ids.description: Ids of the documents to retrieve.

include.description: Fields to include in the results, such as documents, metadatas, or embeddings.

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return.

offset.description: Number of documents to skip before returning results.

where.description: Metadata filter selecting which documents to retrieve.

name: chroma_get_documents
